item.title: Bulletin updated at 02:50 HKT 10/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A weak northeast monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to southern China in the next couple of days. High temperatures will also trigger showers. A broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the latter part of this week to early next week. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early next week. Besides, a broad area of low pressure will affect the vicinity of the East China Sea in the next couple of days.
